desc:
☕ Serve. Upgrade. Collect Pets! 🐾

Welcome To Cloud Café! Start with a small café and grow it into your dream coffee shop.

🍰 SERVE CUSTOMERS — Brew coffee, cook tasty food, and keep the orders coming!
⭐ UPGRADE YOUR CAFÉ — Unlock better coffee machines and stoves, hire workers, and expand your café.
🐾 COLLECT CUTE PETS — Hatch companions, bring them along, and combine matching pets to level them up!
💚 PLAY WITH FRIENDS — Get +5% café income per friend in your server, up to +25%.

Take a break on the patios or by the fountain, then get back to building your café!
